system.description:
A fallen angel who became the weapon she believed could end everything.

  • Dark Gift (1st): One weapon hit each round deals +1d6 fire damage, while you have at least one Warlock spell slot unspent. Proficient with all martial weapons.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, issue a command to a creature of Level up to half your level — they must spend their next action complying with a simple non-harmful order. Works on any creature type.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, burst of corrupted holy light in a 30ft radius — undead and fiends take 6d8 radiant (no save), all others take 3d8 fire (Reflex save against your Class Save DC, for half).
